Complete Job description: 
 
 Position: Software Developer. 
 Address: SACRAMENTO CA 
 Project duration: Initially: 6+ Months 
 Only on W2 

 TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS 
 The OEF software will be developed and extended in computer languages and packages chosen to maximize compatibility with the previous software and flexibility for future modifications. Primary languages are Java, Python, and Typescript. Packages used include ActiveMQ, MongoDB, Leaflet, and ComCat (Comprehensive Catalog) earthquake catalog, and OpenSHA (seismic hazard assessment software). Tests of the OEF software can be written in other languages such as C++. 
 The contractor will be able to meet in person on a weekly basis with staff. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
